connectivity.sim_4g_status: Vivo 4G Multi-Operator SIM active — APN data session requires refresh
troubleshooting_steps: 1. Check Wi-Fi Band (2.4GHz vs 5GHz): Swipe down from the top of your Get Smart touchscreen, open Wi-Fi settings, forget the 5GHz network, and connect to a 2.4GHz Wi-Fi network.
2. Refresh 4G SIM Data Session: Open Settings > Network & Internet > Toggle Airplane Mode ON for 10 seconds, then turn it OFF so the built-in 4G SIM reconnects to the strongest carrier tower.
3. Reboot Terminal & Renew TLS Handshake: Hold the physical Power button on the side of the Get Smart for 5 seconds and tap 'Restart' (Reiniciar).
4. Run Connection Test: On the Getnet payment screen, tap Menu > Administrative > Connection Test (Teste de Comunicação).

recent_declines.error_label: Code 51 — Insufficient Funds / Credit Limit Exceeded (Saldo ou Limite Insuficiente)
recent_declines.secondary_decline_code: 05 — Do Not Honor (Transação Não Autorizada pelo Emissor)
recent_declines.cause_explanation: The latest transaction of R$ 340.00 on terminal POS-GN-884120 (Get Smart) was declined by the customer's card-issuing bank with ISO-8583 Error Code 51 (Insufficient Funds / Credit Limit Exceeded). Your card machine hardware and Getnet acquiring host are operating normally.
resolution_steps: 1. Inform the customer that their card issuer declined the transaction due to available limit/balance (Error Code 51).
2. Offer to process the payment using another card, Debit, or generate an instant Pix QR Code directly on the Get Smart screen.
3. If a secondary attempt returns Code 05 (Do Not Honor), ask the customer to unlock the card in their bank app or use chip & PIN instead of contactless.
4. If the terminal ever displays 'Card Read Error' (Erro de Leitura), clean the smartcard reader slot or restart the terminal.
